note: Hand classes for the rows of lua_consts.json that the rules in uiscale/core/lua_consts.py get wrong or cannot decide (J67). Keyed by script id, function, constant index and, when only one use of the constant is meant, its vanilla pc. Every entry has a reason; checked against the script listing (python3 discovery/core/luachunk.py list <file> <func>) and Empire's ui_scale_mod/lua/patches.txt.

overrides.reason: Resizer: draw size = texture pixels x zoom x 2; the theatre-map and radar textures are not in the scaled art, so the x2 carries the UI factor (Empire main#3:K1; the campaign minimap content filled a quarter of its 2x frame, J66 review finding 2)

FindRegion: cursor x back to texture pixels divides by zoom x 2; must change with the draw size or hover and click pick the wrong region (Empire main#23@38); K3 is shared with the centring /2 at pc 15 and 20, which stay
FindRegion: cursor y, as pc 38 (Empire main#23@50)
